title: Grateful Dead Live at Coliseum on 1990-09-07
lineage: Master Cassettes (Maxell MX90)  Tascam 112 -> Korg MR-1, 1bit 2.8MHz -> USB -> Korg Audio Gate Software 24bit 48KHz -> Mastered in Wave Lab 5.0 using UAD Technology -> Traders Little Helper flac8

ai_review.summary: Solid audience recording captures Richfield’s vibe, highlighted by a smoking 'Playing in the Band'.
ai_review.review: The fan‑recorded AUD does an excellent job of conveying the atmosphere of the Richfield show and sounds surprisingly clear for an audience tape. The performance is praised as a strong 1990 outing with Vince’s first appearance on keys and a standout, well‑jammed 'Playing in the Band'.

ai_rating.rationale: Review is uniformly positive about both the musical performance and the audience recording quality; limited to a single detailed review, so confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Captures atmosphere well; solid clarity for an AUD with no major issues noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall jam‑heavy show with good flow; the 'Playing in the Band' segment is highlighted as a peak moment.

band_member_comments.Keys: First show featuring Vince on keyboards, noted positively.
